I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant
Sep 2026 • Solo
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant, and I especially want to recognize my server, Anna. She was extremely polite, patient, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout my meal.

What impressed me most was her initiative. I’m visiting Vietnam and still learning how some Vietnamese dishes are traditionally eaten. Anna didn’t just bring my food and walk away. She took the time to come over, help cut the pork for me, and explain how to eat it with the rice paper. When I thought I needed to dip the rice paper in water, she patiently explained that it was already soft and ready to use.

Those may seem like small things, but when you’re a visitor experiencing unfamiliar food, that kind of patience and hospitality makes a big difference. I never felt rushed or uncomfortable asking questions.

The food was delicious, but Anna’s service made the experience even better. She was warm, professional, patient, and attentive without being overbearing. Thank you, Anna, for making my meal such an enjoyable experience. I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Excellent food that is so fresh and well-seasoned. Staff are so attentive, with great hospitality.
Mar 2025 • Solo
Outstanding food and hospitality (thanks so much, Peter!) at De Tham. Been traveling in Southeast Asia for two months and this is easily one of the top 2 restaurants I've been to. Flew into HCMC in the morning, stopped here for lunch. Saw several menu items I wanted to try and after my first bite, thought to myself that I would be back for dinner. I did return ... that evening! Saw a handful of other solo travelers come and go and have meals in the time I was there for dinner so it's a very relaxed and comfortable setting for those of us eating alone. Also perfect for families for a calmer, quieter setting than perhaps other spots in HCMC. Here's why -- their front doors are sliding glass doors. This is brilliant since you have full view of the many passersby, cars and motorbikes outside. The sliding glass doors also help to keep the air conditioning inside (yes!) and the street noise outside (please and thank you!) It makes for a nice way to enjoy your meal and take a break from honking vehicles. There is also a second floor with a balcony but I did not get the chance to check it out.

saltwaternurse
Fort Lauderdale, Florida2 contributions

Tasty food and great service at reasonable prices
Feb 2025 • Couples
My husband was looking for somewhere for our last dinner in HCMC and found De Tham. We were warmly greeted and fortunately for us, a comfortable table had just opened up so we were quickly seated. 

The menu is good with plenty of regional options plus a fairly extensive vegetarian/vegan selection. Our waiter, Jack, was very attentive, knowledgeable and friendly so any questions we had were answered and we felt very well taken care of. 

My husband ordered us the fried eggplant as a starter and had the grilled beef served in bamboo as his entree while I enjoyed the caramelized pork and quail eggs. I had a glass of red wine from Dalat Vietnam and a lime soda (lime juice, a can of soda water and a small jug of simple syrup so you can mix it to your palate!) and my husband tried a couple of the Vietnamese beers they offered. 

The eggplant was crispy and tasty and we enjoyed the chili sauce for dipping so much that Jack brought us more. The beef was delicious, tasted chargrilled and looked appealing served up in bamboo. My bowl of pork and quail eggs was so comforting, the broth tasted like it had been simmered with love for hours at Grandmas house. 

We shouldn’t have ordered the banana split to share but we did and had no regrets, it too, was well executed. Prices are reasonable for District 1 and portions quite generous. Thank you Jack for taking such good care of us!
